english.title: Master of ship / commander of aircraft fail to comply with demand for return of clearance
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the

(A)_[master of a ship,]_
(B)_[commander of an aircraft,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP / AIRCRAFT..), failed to comply with a demand for the return of a clearance made by a proper officer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER..), under section 65(1)(b) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979
english.legislation: Contrary to section 65(3)(b) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
